cases.notes: Amtssignatur of the Bundeskanzleramt, chain a-sign-corporate-07 -> A-Trust-Root-07, no timestamp. DSS qualification UNKNOWN: the Austrian trusted list carries the CA as 'CA/PKC, recognised at national level', not as a qualified certificate issuer. Offline the result is INDETERMINATE because revocation data must be fetched. Signing-time attribute present, hence PAdES-BES rather than BASELINE-B.
